recent.text: Another tough loss. Barnes deserved a better fate in his return. He had 16 of his 30 points in the 4th quarter and OT, including 14 of the Raptors’ final 20 points. But too many bad mistakes as a team (and another 5+ minute scoring drought) in the 4th before Scottie took over.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg

recent.text: Nice to have your 2-way star back. Scottie Barnes scored the Raptors' final 9 points in regulation, including a circus shot and the game-tying step back 3-ball. He also stopped Jalen Brunson (1 of the game's great clutch players) on the final possession. Overtime!
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
